school.tagged_body:
My Family Trip to Hanoi
Posted by Yuri | August 15, 2026

Last week, my family spent five days in Hanoi. Hanoi is the {{v:capital}} of Vietnam. It was my first trip to another country. I want to share some of my favorite memories.

{{g:The first thing that surprised me|주격 관계대명사 that: 나를 놀라게 한 첫 번째 것}} was the {{v:traffic}}. There were thousands of {{v:motorbikes}} on the streets. When we crossed the road, it felt like an {{v:adventure}}! Our tour guide {{g:told us to walk|tell + 목적어 + to부정사: ~에게 …하라고 말하다}} slowly and {{v:steadily}}. That way, drivers could see us and go around us.

On the second day, we visited Hoan Kiem Lake. It is in the center of the city. In the evening, cars could not go on the streets around the lake. {{v:Local}} families {{g:came out to dance|to부정사 부사적 용법(목적): ~하기 위해}}, play games, and enjoy street food.

I really loved Vietnamese food. My favorite was bun cha. It is {{v:grilled}} pork with rice noodles and fresh {{v:herbs}}. It cost only about 50,000 dong. That is less than 3,000 won!

The best part of our trip was a boat tour of Ha Long Bay. Ha Long Bay is {{v:famous for}} its thousands of limestone islands. The {{v:view}} was {{g:so beautiful that I couldn't stop|so + 형용사 + that + 주어 + 동사: 너무 ~해서 …하다}} {{g:taking pictures|stop + -ing: ~하는 것을 멈추다}}.

{{t:If you ever have a chance, please visit Hanoi.}} I really recommend it!

questions.answer: Grilled pork with rice noodles and fresh herbs

questions.answer: so

questions.answer: Visit Hanoi if you have a chance.

academy.tagged_body:
My Family Trip to Hanoi
Posted by Yuri | August 15, 2026

Last week, my family spent five days in Hanoi, the {{v:capital}} of Vietnam. It was my first trip {{v:abroad}}, and I want to share some of my favorite memories.

{{g:The first thing that surprised me|주격 관계대명사 that: 나를 놀라게 한 첫 번째 것}} was the {{v:traffic}}. There were thousands of motorbikes on the streets, and crossing the road felt like an {{v:adventure}}! Our tour guide {{g:told us to walk|tell + 목적어 + to부정사: ~에게 …하라고 말하다}} slowly and {{v:steadily}} {{g:so that drivers could see us|so that + 주어 + could: ~가 …할 수 있도록 (목적)}} and go around us.

On the second day, we visited Hoan Kiem Lake in the center of the city. In the evening, the streets around the lake were {{g:closed to cars|수동태 be closed to: ~에게 통행이 금지되다}}, and local families came out to dance, play games, and enjoy street food.

Speaking of food, I fell in love with Vietnamese {{v:cuisine}}. My favorite was bun cha, {{g:grilled pork served with|과거분사의 명사 수식: ~와 함께 나오는(제공되는) 구운 돼지고기}} rice noodles and fresh herbs. It cost only about 50,000 dong, {{g:which is less than 3,000 won|계속적 용법 관계대명사 which = and it (앞 내용 50,000 dong을 보충 설명)}}!

The {{v:highlight}} of our trip was a boat tour of Ha Long Bay, {{g:which is famous for|계속적 용법 관계대명사 which: 앞의 Ha Long Bay를 보충 설명}} its thousands of {{v:limestone}} islands. The view was {{g:so beautiful that I couldn't stop taking pictures|so ~ that 구문 + stop -ing: 너무 ~해서 …하는 것을 멈출 수 없었다}}.

If you ever have a chance, {{t:I highly recommend visiting Hanoi!}}

questions.q: What is the purpose of the passage?
choices: To explain the history of Vietnam
To share memories of a family trip to Hanoi and recommend visiting it
To warn people about dangerous traffic
To advertise a boat tour company
To compare Korean and Vietnamese food
questions.answer: To share memories of a family trip to Hanoi and recommend visiting it
questions.explanation: 여행에서 가장 좋았던 기억을 나누고(I want to share ~), 마지막에 하노이 방문을 추천한다(I highly recommend visiting Hanoi).

questions.q: What kind of writing is this?
questions.answer: A travel blog post
questions.explanation: 'Posted by Yuri | August 15, 2026'과 개인적인 여행 경험을 공유하는 내용으로 보아 여행 블로그 글이다.

questions.q: Which is true about the trip?
choices: It was the writer's first trip abroad.
The family stayed in Hanoi for a week.
The writer visited Ha Long Bay on the first day.
questions.answer: It was the writer's first trip abroad.
questions.explanation: 'It was my first trip abroad'과 일치한다. 5일 동안 가족과 함께, 지난주에 다녀왔다.

questions.q: Why did the tour guide tell them to walk slowly and steadily?
choices: So that they could take pictures of the motorbikes
So that they could arrive at the lake on time
So that drivers could see them and go around them
Because walking fast was against the law
questions.answer: So that drivers could see them and go around them
questions.explanation: 'so that drivers could see us and go around us'에서 so that은 '~하도록'이라는 목적을 나타낸다.

questions.q: What does "crossing the road felt like an adventure" suggest?
choices: Crossing the road was very easy.
Crossing the road was not allowed.
Crossing the road took several hours.
Crossing the road was exciting but a little scary.
questions.answer: Crossing the road was exciting but a little scary.
questions.explanation: 수천 대의 오토바이 사이로 길을 건너는 것이 모험처럼 느껴졌다는 것은 짜릿하면서도 조금 무서웠다는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Why could local families dance and play games in the streets around the lake?
choices: Because it was a national holiday
Because the streets were closed to cars in the evening
Because the tour guide asked them to
Because there were no motorbikes in Hanoi
questions.answer: Because the streets were closed to cars in the evening
questions.explanation: 'In the evening, the streets around the lake were closed to cars'이므로 가족들이 거리로 나와 놀 수 있었다.

questions.q: What is the role of "Speaking of food" in the fourth paragraph?
choices: It shows that the writer does not like food.
It gives a reason for the traffic problem.
It ends the story of the trip.
It moves to a new topic connected to the street food mentioned before.
questions.answer: It moves to a new topic connected to the street food mentioned before.
questions.explanation: 앞 문단 끝의 'enjoy street food'를 이어 받아 음식 이야기로 자연스럽게 넘어가는 표현이다 (~ 얘기가 나와서 말인데).

questions.q: Which is NOT mentioned about bun cha?
choices: It is the most popular dish in Vietnam.
It is served with rice noodles.
questions.answer: It is the most popular dish in Vietnam.
questions.explanation: 분짜가 베트남에서 가장 인기 있는 음식이라는 내용은 없다. 글쓴이가 가장 좋아한(My favorite) 음식일 뿐이다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from "It cost only about 50,000 dong, which is less than 3,000 won!"?
choices: The writer thought bun cha was too expensive.
Bun cha costs the same in Korea.
The writer paid in Korean won.
The writer thought bun cha was very cheap.
The writer did not finish the meal.
questions.answer: The writer thought bun cha was very cheap.
questions.explanation: only와 느낌표(!), '3,000원도 안 된다'는 비교로 보아 아주 싸다고 느꼈음을 알 수 있다.

questions.q: Which is closest in meaning to 'cuisine'?
choices: a style of cooking or food
questions.answer: a style of cooking or food
questions.explanation: cuisine은 '(특정 나라·지역의) 요리, 요리법'이라는 뜻이다. Vietnamese cuisine = 베트남 요리.

questions.q: What does 'highlight' mean in the passage?
choices: the best or most exciting part
questions.answer: the best or most exciting part
questions.explanation: highlight는 '가장 좋은(흥미로운) 부분'이라는 뜻이다. 여행의 백미가 하롱베이 보트 투어였다는 말이다.

questions.q: 'abroad'의 의미로 가장 알맞은 것은?
questions.answer: 외국으로, 해외로
questions.explanation: abroad는 '외국으로, 해외로'라는 뜻이다. my first trip abroad = 나의 첫 해외여행.

questions.q: What does "which" in the fifth paragraph refer to?
questions.answer: Ha Long Bay
questions.explanation: 'Ha Long Bay, which is famous for its thousands of limestone islands' — 수천 개의 석회암 섬으로 유명한 것은 하롱베이이다.

questions.q: Which is NOT true according to the passage?
choices: Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam.
The streets around the lake were closed to cars all day long.
There were thousands of motorbikes on the streets.
Bun cha comes with rice noodles and fresh herbs.
The writer took many pictures at Ha Long Bay.
questions.answer: The streets around the lake were closed to cars all day long.
questions.explanation: 거리는 하루 종일이 아니라 저녁에(In the evening) 차량 통행이 금지되었다.

questions.q: Where would the following sentence best fit? "Some of them looked like giant animals rising out of the green water."
choices: After "...so that drivers could see us and go around us."
After "...famous for its thousands of limestone islands."
After "If you ever have a chance, I highly recommend visiting Hanoi!"
questions.answer: After "...famous for its thousands of limestone islands."
questions.explanation: Some of them(그것들 중 일부)은 수천 개의 석회암 섬(thousands of limestone islands)을 가리키므로 그 바로 뒤가 알맞다.

questions.q: Which sentence is grammatically INCORRECT?
choices: Bun cha is grilled pork serving with rice noodles.
The view was so beautiful that I couldn't stop taking pictures.
Our guide told us to walk slowly.
Ha Long Bay is famous for its limestone islands.
It was my first trip abroad.
questions.answer: Bun cha is grilled pork serving with rice noodles.
questions.explanation: 돼지고기가 '제공되는' 것이므로 수동의 의미인 과거분사 served가 와야 한다 (grilled pork served with ~).

questions.q: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? "Our tour guide told us to walk slowly and steadily ____ drivers could see us."
questions.answer: so that
questions.explanation: '~가 …할 수 있도록'의 목적은 so that + 주어 + could. because of·in order to 뒤에는 절(주어+동사)이 올 수 없다.

questions.q: Which best completes the summary? "During the trip, the writer experienced exciting (A) ____, enjoyed tasty and (B) ____ food, and saw beautiful islands."
questions.answer: (A) traffic – (B) cheap
questions.explanation: 모험 같았던 교통(traffic), 3,000원도 안 되는 싼(cheap) 분짜, 하롱베이의 섬들을 요약한 것이다.

items: The writer described the highlight: a boat tour of Ha Long Bay.

answer: The writer was surprised by thousands of motorbikes.
The writer visited Hoan Kiem Lake on the second day.

essays.q: Why did the tour guide tell the family to walk slowly and steadily? Answer in a complete English sentence.
essays.sampleAnswer: The guide told them to walk slowly and steadily so that drivers could see them and go around them.
essays.rubric: ① 운전자가 볼 수 있도록(see them) ② 피해 갈 수 있도록(go around them) ③ 완전한 영어 문장, 문법 오류 없음

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 저녁에 호안끼엠 호수 주변 거리는 어떤 모습이었는지, 차량 통행과 지역 가족들의 활동을 포함하여 쓰시오.

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '가이드는 운전자들이 우리를 볼 수 있도록 천천히 걸으라고 우리에게 말했다.' <조건> tell + 목적어 + to부정사를 사용할 것 / so that을 사용할 것 / 과거시제로 쓸 것
essays.sampleAnswer: The guide told us to walk slowly so that drivers could see us.
essays.rubric: ① told us to walk ② so that + 주어 + could ③ 과거시제 ④ 의미 일치

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 글쓴이가 분짜(bun cha)를 아주 싸다고 느꼈다는 것을 알 수 있는 근거를 본문에서 두 가지 찾아 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: ① '단지(only) 약 50,000동'이라고 only를 써서 강조했다. ② 그 가격이 우리 돈 3,000원도 안 된다고 비교하며 느낌표(!)로 놀라움을 나타냈다.
essays.rubric: ① only의 강조 ② 3,000원 미만이라는 비교(또는 느낌표의 놀라움) — 두 근거 모두 쓰면 만점

essays.q: Write two English sentences recommending a place you have visited. Use "If you ever have a chance, I highly recommend ~ing" in one of them.
essays.sampleAnswer: Last summer, I visited Jeju Island with my family. If you ever have a chance, I highly recommend climbing Hallasan.

My Family Trip to Hanoi
Posted by Yuri | August 15, 2026

Last week, my family spent five {{v:unforgettable}} days in Hanoi, the capital city of Vietnam. Since it was my very first trip {{v:abroad}}, I would like to share some of {{g:the memories that I treasure most|목적격 관계대명사 that: 내가 가장 소중히 여기는 기억들}}.

The first thing that {{v:caught me by surprise}} was the traffic. Thousands of motorbikes filled the streets, {{g:so crossing the road felt like a real adventure|동명사 주어(crossing the road) + feel like + 명사: ~처럼 느껴지다}}! Our tour guide {{g:advised us to walk|advise + 목적어 + to부정사: ~에게 …하라고 조언하다}} slowly and {{v:steadily}} so that drivers could {{g:see us coming|지각동사 see + 목적어 + -ing: ~가 …하고 있는 것을 보다}} and simply go around us.

On our second day, we visited Hoan Kiem Lake, {{g:which is located in|계속적 용법 관계대명사 which + be located in: ~에 위치해 있다}} the heart of the city. In the evening, the streets {{v:surrounding}} the lake were closed to cars, and local families gathered there to dance, play games, and enjoy street food.

Speaking of food, I completely fell in love with Vietnamese {{v:cuisine}}. My favorite dish was bun cha, which {{v:consists of}} grilled pork served with rice noodles and fresh herbs. Surprisingly, it cost only about 50,000 dong, which is less than 3,000 won!

The {{v:highlight}} of the entire trip was a boat tour of Ha Long Bay, {{g:a place famous for|동격: Ha Long Bay = a place (which is) famous for ~}} its thousands of limestone islands. The scenery was {{g:so breathtaking that I couldn't stop taking pictures|so ~ that 구문 + stop -ing}}.

If you ever get the chance, {{g:I highly recommend that you visit Hanoi!|recommend that + 주어 + (should) 동사원형: 당위의 should가 생략되어 visits가 아닌 visit}}

prestudy.tagged_body:
My Family Trip to Hanoi
Posted by Yuri | August 15, 2026

Last week, my family spent five memorable days in Hanoi, the {{v:bustling}} capital of Vietnam. {{g:Having never traveled overseas before|완료 분사구문(부정): = Because I had never traveled overseas before}}, I would like to share a few of {{g:the experiences that left the deepest impression on me|주격 관계대명사 that + leave an impression on: ~에게 깊은 인상을 남기다}}.

{{g:What astonished me first|관계대명사 what이 이끄는 명사절 주어: 나를 처음 깜짝 놀라게 한 것}} was the traffic: thousands of motorbikes flooded the streets, {{g:turning every road crossing into an adventure|분사구문(결과) + turn A into B: A를 B로 바꾸다}}! Our tour guide {{g:instructed us to walk|instruct + 목적어 + to부정사: ~에게 …하라고 지시하다}} slowly and steadily so that drivers could {{v:anticipate}} our movements and {{v:steer}} around us.

On the second day, we visited Hoan Kiem Lake, {{g:situated in|과거분사구의 명사 수식: (which is) situated in ~ (~에 위치한)}} the very center of the city. In the evening, the surrounding streets were closed to vehicles, and local families poured out to dance, play games, and {{v:savor}} street food.

Speaking of food, I became utterly {{v:captivated}} by Vietnamese cuisine. My personal favorite was bun cha, a dish of grilled pork {{v:accompanied by}} rice noodles and fresh herbs. Remarkably, it cost {{g:a mere 50,000 dong|a mere + 수량: 겨우 ~에 불과한 (양이 적음을 강조)}}, which amounts to less than 3,000 won!

Without a doubt, the highlight of our journey was a boat tour of Ha Long Bay, {{v:renowned for}} its thousands of limestone islands. {{g:So breathtaking was the scenery that|so ~ that 도치: So + 형용사 + 동사 + 주어 + that (= The scenery was so breathtaking that)}} I could not stop taking photographs.

{{g:Should you ever have the opportunity|if 생략 도치: = If you should ever have the opportunity}}, {{t:I would wholeheartedly recommend visiting Hanoi!}}

grammar: so ~ that 도치 (So + 형용사 + V + S)

questions.answer: So breathtaking the scenery was that I could not stop taking photographs.

questions.answer: So exhausted was he that he fell asleep at once.

essays.q: Explain in 2–3 English sentences why walking slowly and steadily was safer than running when crossing the streets of Hanoi.
essays.sampleAnswer: When pedestrians walk slowly and steadily, drivers can anticipate where they will be. As a result, the drivers can steer around them safely. If people run suddenly, drivers cannot predict their movements, which can cause accidents.
essays.rubric: ① 운전자가 움직임을 예측 가능 ② 피해 갈 수 있음 ③ 갑자기 뛰면 예측 불가(대조) ④ 영어 문장 2~3개, 문법 오류 없음

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 'Having never traveled overseas before, I would like to share ~'에서 분사구문을 접속사가 있는 절로 바꿔 영어로 쓰고, Having + p.p. 형태를 쓴 이유를 설명하시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 절: Because I had never traveled overseas before / 이유: 해외여행을 해 본 적이 없었던 것이 글을 쓰는 시점(주절)보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 완료 분사구문(Having + p.p.)을 썼고, 부정어 never는 분사 앞에 둔다.
essays.rubric: ① Because I had never traveled overseas before ② 주절보다 앞선 시점 → 완료 분사구문 ③ never의 위치 — 모두 쓰면 만점

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '그 음식이 너무 맛있어서 나는 두 그릇을 먹었다.' <조건> So로 시작하는 도치 구문을 사용할 것 / delicious와 bowls를 사용할 것 / 과거시제로 쓸 것
essays.sampleAnswer: So delicious was the food that I ate two bowls.
essays.rubric: ① So delicious was the food (도치) ② that I ate ③ two bowls ④ 과거시제, 의미 일치

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 글쓴이가 하노이에서 겪은 네 가지 장면(교통, 호수, 음식, 하롱베이)에서 각각 어떤 감정을 느꼈는지, 그 감정을 드러내는 본문 표현과 함께 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: ① 교통: 깜짝 놀라고 짜릿함 — astonished, adventure ② 호수: 활기차고 즐거움 — families poured out to dance, play games ③ 음식: 매료되고 놀람 — utterly captivated, Remarkably, a mere ④ 하롱베이: 감탄 — highlight, So breathtaking was the scenery
essays.rubric: 네 장면마다 감정 + 근거 표현을 쓰면 만점, 세 장면이면 부분 점수

essays.q: Summarize the passage in about 40 English words. Include the traffic, the lake, the food, and Ha Long Bay.
essays.sampleAnswer: On the writer's first trip overseas, crossing Hanoi's motorbike-filled streets felt like an adventure, and families enjoyed car-free evenings by Hoan Kiem Lake. The writer loved cheap, tasty bun cha, and a boat tour of Ha Long Bay was the highlight.
essays.rubric: ① 교통 ② 호수 ③ 음식(분짜) ④ 하롱베이 ⑤ 40단어 내외

wordbook.sentence: Last week, my family spent five memorable days in Hanoi, the bustling capital of Vietnam.
Our tour guide instructed us to walk slowly and steadily so that drivers could anticipate our movements and steer around us.
Our tour guide instructed us to walk slowly and steadily so that drivers could anticipate our movements and steer around us.
In the evening, the surrounding streets were closed to vehicles, and local families poured out to dance, play games, and savor street food.
Speaking of food, I became utterly captivated by Vietnamese cuisine.
My personal favorite was bun cha, a dish of grilled pork accompanied by rice noodles and fresh herbs.
Without a doubt, the highlight of our journey was a boat tour of Ha Long Bay, renowned for its thousands of limestone islands.
